context.goal: Separate website code from client-editable menu data and images into two repositories for simplified client updates and Netlify deployment.

sushimist_web.description: Private repository for the main Astro application code.
content: Main Astro application code (src/pages, src/components, src/layouts, src/styles, etc.)

sushimist_menu.description: Public repository for client-editable menu data and images.

current_task.objective: Prepare the local environment for the two-repository structure.

subtasks.description: Correctly create the necessary directory structure for the public menu repository content.
Move the current `src/config.ts` to the temporary directory for the public menu repository.

subtasks.expected_outcome: `src/config.ts` is removed from the main project.

subtasks.description: Add `src/config.ts` and `src/assets/menu/` to `.gitignore` in the `sushimist-web` repository to prevent accidental commits.
Generate detailed instructions for setting up Netlify to pull from two repositories.
